nodes.title: Provenance staleness: record effective-parent versions per output version, traversing through process nodes
nodes.summary: In a provenance/lineage graph, don't decide staleness per edge (edge.source_version refreshed when the target is saved). When a pipeline has several outputs and only one is regenerated, the refresh of the pipeline's input edges silently marks the siblings fresh. Instead each saved version of a data node records the versions of its effective parents: direct sources plus, through process nodes (pipeline/step/script), the inputs of the process that made it.
nodes.detail: Rules that worked in Sciweave: data node stale if any effective parent's current version != recorded one, or a data parent is itself stale; process nodes are never 'rebuilt', they are flagged 're-run needed' when any of their outputs recorded an older input version; article placements compare placed version vs final/current; informational links (documents/related) never propagate. On new links, setdefault the current versions into the target's latest version (or into all outputs of a process target). A 'cosmetic save' copies the previous version's parents so a font-only re-render stays stale.
